scores.evidence: The loop-diagram flowchart TD fits the 390 px screen with readable Japanese labels (pages/mobile-jp-04.png, mobile-jp-05.png). The two-column loop-table and surfaces-table wrap cleanly on mobile (mobile-jp-03.png, mobile-jp-07.png). install-unix is split into two lines and shows in full without sideways scrolling (mobile-jp-09.png). The 8-line example-diff fits on mobile without soft-wrapping (mobile-jp-14.png, mobile-jp-15.png).

textOnlyScreens is empty on both desktop and mobile. Every screen has a table, diagram, code block, steps card or quiz, and the full page has no walls of text or empty gaps. Desktop chars-per-line median is 39, inside the 30–40 target.

All visible text, including the diagram labels, is Japanese, with English shown only in the intended glosses (e.g. エージェントループ（agentic loop）). The diagram has a caption and a '図の説明を読む' toggle (mobile-jp-05.png). No controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars, and contrast is good throughout. No awkward line breaks inside Japanese words on mobile.

niceToHave: practice-checklist: on screen, 'claude --versionで…' and '/diffで…' show as plain bold text, not code chips (pages/mobile-jp-20.png, mobile-jp-21.png, desktop-jp-14.png). If checklist labels support inline code, use `claude --version` and `/diff` to match the rest of the lesson. If they do not: reader: render inline code in checklist labels.

check-quiz q5 option a: on desktop, a single 'る' wraps onto its own line ('…結果を確かめ / る', pages/desktop-jp-15.png). Shortening it slightly (e.g. '補完と違い、Claude Codeはツールで自分から調べ、変更し、確かめる') would keep it on one line.

reader: the 用語・このレッスン side panel lists エージェントループ twice, once as 'エージェントループ (agentic loop)' and once as plain 'エージェントループ' (pages/desktop-jp-01.png and other desktop screens). Glossary entries and definitions terms should be deduplicated.
reader: the diff code block (example-diff) colours + lines the same as context lines (pages/desktop-jp-10.png). Green colouring for added lines would make the diff easier to read.

reader (known, not a lesson defect): the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px (metrics truncated: true; per-screen PNGs cover the whole page). The end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-28.png, desktop-jp-20.png). Failed /api/ requests are environment noise.
summary: No hard failures in metrics.json (overflowX false; 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block and broken-image errors), no text-only screens, and no personal data on any screen. The vertical loop diagram, the two-column tables and the split install command all read well at 390 px, and the inline code chips and code blocks are never cut off. Only small polish items remain: code formatting in the checklist labels, one orphaned character in a desktop quiz option, and reader-side fixes for the duplicate glossary chip and diff colouring.
